finalists.label: Cardiac Metastasis
finalists.why: It has specific evidence from the vignette, including lung cancer with metastatic disease to the myocardium and a well-circumscribed mass in the left ventricle.

finalists.label: Pericardial Effusion
finalists.why: It is directly supported by the finding of a large pericardial effusion with signs of impending cardiac tamponade.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of a well-circumscribed mass in the left ventricle and the history of lung cancer with metastatic disease to the myocardium specifically support Cardiac Metastasis over the more general finding of Pericardial Effusion.
